items.title: "Wooden Joe" Nicholas Interview, 1956-11-12
items.q: He used to blow a clarinet. I tried many times practically, but I never could do it.

ctx.x: Did you hear the TOs? How were they?

He used to do better than all of them, all of them. To me, I don't know about it but to me. He used to have to work, work with everybody. He used to blow a clarinet. I tried many times practically, but I never could do it. He'd never come out like that, ain't he? Puffy jawed out. He'd never go out like that. He'd never seen him look like he ain't blind.
Never did puff him out then?
